note: ACCEPTED regression baseline. scripts/evaluate.ts DERIVES its CI floors from these numbers — each metric minus exactly one case of slack (falseRefusalRate plus one case) — so a floor can never drift away from the value it protects. Moving a floor therefore means editing this file, which is a visible diff. Re-baseline only from a run you have actually read: copy the headline block of the evals/results/retrieval-<date>-<sha>.json you are accepting.
acceptedDebt: refusalRecall is now 11/11 on this run; the previously accepted 10/11 debt no longer applies at this configuration, but the floor still allows one regression case before failing.
corpusCaveat: docsCommit is the ONLY handle on the corpus these numbers were measured against — data/liara-docs and data/index are gitignored, and scripts/sync-docs.mjs pulls upstream HEAD. evaluate.ts warns when the index docsCommit differs from the one above, so a floor failure caused by upstream docs moving can be told apart from a code regression.
